runtime_choices.kernel_backend: tilelang: TileLang 0.1.15 (patches/tilelang 0001-0003), DeepSeek's TileKernels 2.0.0 and sparknet 0.2.0 run the attention metadata, indexer, dense projections, experts, router, mHC, vocabulary heads and collectives (r6d's series), and now also the CSA compressor (one launch), the KV cache writers, the sparse-MLA metadata kernels (the first port off Triton) and a MoE combine that adds the shared expert's output in its single rounding (vLLM 0081-0110); the fused WO projection, the Engram table lookup and the sparse-MLA attention kernel stay B12X kernels; the L2 prefetch and sparknet's default collectives stay CuTe
runtime_choices.B12X_W4A8_TINY_DECODE: 0 (tiny decode omits swiglu_limit; see experiment README)
runtime_choices.B12X_AUTOTUNE: 0 (autotune race budget is free memory // 2 on unified memory)
runtime_choices.speculative: DSpark, 5 tokens (the drafter's trained block), draft TP 4, adaptive verification cost scale 2 on curves profiled for this image (ring4-r6-20261005), dead verification rows below survival 0.2, block rejection; greedy drafts vocabulary-parallel (vLLM patch 0012) over the checkpoint's BF16 draft head (the target head's own tensor) and BF16 Markov projection (VLLM_DS41_DRAFT_NVFP4_HEAD=0, VLLM_DS41_MARKOV_NVFP4=0), and a column-sharded drafter main_proj (0013)
runtime_choices.cudagraph: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, capture sizes 1-96 (16 streams at 1 + 5 rows)
runtime_choices.flashinfer_autotune: disabled (--no-enable-flashinfer-autotune): it saved 0 configs, and only the sampler uses FlashInfer
runtime_choices.engram_projection: sharded across ranks (projection_tp, padded to 25632 rows by vLLM patch 0001)
runtime_choices.multimodal: vision tower loaded (no --language-model-only), up to 4 images per request; --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 (vLLM's default 4 GiB host cache would come out of dgx1's guard margin)
runtime_choices.host_sysctl: vm.watermark_boost_factor=0 on every node (/etc/sysctl.d/90-watermark-boost.conf): a watermark boost hides up to 0.87 GiB from MemAvailable, which the memory guards read
runtime_choices.l2_prefetch: on (the base's default on SM121): side-stream L2 prefetch of the next decode projections; it compiles from r5i on (quack-kernels needs CuTe DSL 4.7), so earlier baselines recorded it on while it disabled itself at startup; the TileLang scale words ride with each projection's weight (vLLM 0044)
runtime_choices.nccl: 2.30.7 rebuilt with patches/nccl (NVIDIA/nccl#2393 IB send-path fence and the four-node ring patches) in place of the base image's wheel
runtime_choices.chat_template_defaults: none: thinking is the default when a request names neither key, so a client's enable_thinking=false is honored
runtime_choices.prefill: sequence-parallel once a forward's reduce-scatter exceeds the one-shot RoCE all-reduce (205 tokens; vLLM patches 0014-0018, no setting): per-layer all-reduces become reduce-scatters, row-wise work runs on a third of the rows, CED encoder layers only
runtime_choices.host: mutating torch custom ops read their argument schema once per call (vLLM patch 0019, vllm/env_override.py), not once per argument
runtime_choices.cutlass_dsl: 4.7.1 for every consumer (vLLM, quack-kernels, B12X via patch 0002, FlashInfer, cuDNN frontend)
runtime_choices.jit_caches: driver PTX JIT cache (CUDA_CACHE_PATH, 4 GiB limit) and TileLang cache on the /cache mount, beside the B12X, CuTe DSL, FlashInfer and Triton caches
runtime_choices.jit_warmup: the dead-row variants of the draft combine and sampled/rejected-count Triton kernels are compiled at warmup (vLLM patch 0020); no kernel compiles after readiness
runtime_choices.display_carveout: SPARK3_DISPLAY_CARVEOUT_WEIGHTS=1 with the GB10 display device passed to the container: embed_tokens and the packed lm_head are created in the firmware scanout reserve and the checkpoint loader writes straight into them (vLLM 0030); the text console keeps its 8 MiB framebuffer
runtime_choices.attention_compute: VLLM_DS41_ATTENTION_COMPUTE=auto (B12X's tuned arithmetic; BF16 pending a fidelity test)
runtime_choices.indexer_split: always under sequence-parallel prefill (patch 0025; SPARK3_DS41_INDEXER_SPLIT_CHECK=1 validates it against the full-row indexer)
runtime_choices.topk_ties: lowest logical position (B12X 0003); indexer selections repeat exactly (B12X backend)
runtime_choices.dense_gemm_stage_release: async-proxy fence before each TMA-refilled stage release (B12X 0004) (B12X backend)
runtime_choices.prefill_stage_release: async-proxy fence before each TMA-refilled stage release in the BF16 and mHC prefill projections and contiguous attention (B12X 0005) (B12X backend)
runtime_choices.host_memory: 64 KiB pages; memory-saver DKMS 0.2.0, UVM leaf-table packing enabled; THP never, vm.min_free_kbytes=45166, /swap-64k.img
runtime_choices.vocabulary_head: exact 12-bit packed BF16 (VLLM_DS41_PACKED_BF16_LM_HEAD=1; B12X 0012, vLLM 0028): a 4-bit exponent window code plus a per-row list of out-of-window values, bit-identical to the BF16 weights; logits in FP32 (VLLM_DS41_HEAD_DTYPE=float32, the reference's head_dtype)
runtime_choices.collective_policy: sparknet's one-shot RoCE all-reduce up to 2 MiB (SPARKNET_ROCE_ALLREDUCE_DISPATCH_MAX_BYTES=2097152) and all-gather over the ring (oneshot-ring4); sequence-parallel reduce-scatters exchange unreduced chunks through NCCL send/recv (opposite ranks relayed through the neighbours) and add them in rank order
runtime_choices.profiling_context: the fabricated context of startup profiling and dummy runs takes its own blocks per KV cache group and request (vLLM 0039), so no group reads another group's records
runtime_choices.four_node_transports: B12X's RoCEnante transports and NCCL 0002-0004 remain in the image; TileLang configurations use sparknet's ring4 transport at TP4
runtime_choices.decode_tiles: block-32 FP8 decode rows on 16-, 32- or 64-row tiles by row count, and split-K tiles up to 128 rows for 16-stream steps (D1), TileLang's unspecialized pipeline; prefill rasterizes weights larger than L2 in panels (vLLM 0043)
runtime_choices.batch_invariance: temperature-0 outputs do not depend on the batch: the reduce-scatter and all-reduces past the one-shot limit add every rank's partial in FP32 in rank order with one rounding, the compressor projection runs one TileLang arithmetic at every row count, prefill chunks align (threshold 8096 = budget - 16 x (1 + 5) decode rows), and a mixed step runs sparse MLA per request, so decode rows keep the decode plan beside a prefill
runtime_choices.reference_precision: DeepSeek's reference inference/model.py term for term where r6d rounded early: FP32 logits; the mHC stream projection in FP32, each FP32 weight split into three exact TF32 parts; the shared expert's SwiGLU in FP32 with one rounding; MoE partials rounded once per rank. The known deviation left is WO-A's FP8 activations

change_from_previous: TP4 and TP3 move to r6f: r6d plus vLLM 0081-0110 (FP32 logits, FP32 mHC projection, FP32 shared-expert SwiGLU, one-rounding MoE partials with the shared expert folded into the combine, rank-order collectives past the one-shot limit, the new TileLang ports, the sequence-parallel WO overlap and fused sum, and the per-request sparse-MLA split of mixed steps). The TP3 profiles leave r6's frozen lock (threshold 4048 = 4096 - 8 x 6, sparknet dispatch to 2 MiB, Engram overlap off).

evidence.summary: Release comparison against r6d, one session per topology with r6d first (lab profiles release and release-tp3). TP4 2026-10-11 18:17-19:30 UTC on the ring: temperature-0 fifteen streams plus a long prompt 14 of 16 requests differing on r6d, 0 on r6f, every other scenario identical; quality 5/5; real-text prefill 5,842 / 5,763 / 5,490 / 5,064 / 4,377 tok/s at 32K / 128K / 256K / 512K / 1M (+1.1% to +2.3%, faster beyond the intervals); different prompts at once +0.7% / -0.2% / -1.8% at 4 / 8 / 16 streams (-1.8% beyond its +-0.6% interval); the sixteen-prompt paired sweep at one stream -0.1% +-2.4%; minimum MemAvailable 20.19 GiB (dgx1); no thermal slowdown. TP3 2026-10-11 on the triangle: every scenario identical on both; quality 5/5; prefill level (-0.7% to +0.5%); 4 different prompts at once -3.1% +-0.2%, 8 level; paired sweep -1.9% +-2.1%; minimum MemAvailable 6.64 GiB (dgx1). Both r6f arms mounted r6f's sources on the r6d image; the baked image builds the same vLLM tree (4127ff975d84, image label). The baked image, live on TP4 2026-10-11 21:01 UTC: token_determinism.py --wide identical in every scenario with references 7ae87256d3ea / b8b35451dcc4, equal to the overlay arms' (experiments/2026-10-11-r6f/image-determinism.jsonl).
